title: Phantsi komthunzi we-Date Palm
intro: Ibali livela ngomphefumlo owahlulwe ngaphambi kokuzalwa, okhuliswe ngaphakathi kweendonga ezingcwele, waza wakhethwa ukuba athwale umqondiso ongazange ubonwe lihlabathi. Xa kwavela isityholo kuzo zonke iindlela, kwavela ilizwi elivela kwiindawo ezingalindelekanga ukuze kupheliswe amathandabuzo. Ungamfumana na umntu ohamba phantsi komthunzi wesundu?
clues: Ndazinikela kwinkonzo kaSomandla ngaphambi kokuba ndiphefumle okokuqala, isifungo esenziwe ngumntu ondithweleyo.
Ndikhulele phantsi kokhathalelo oluluqilima lomgcini olungileyo ngaphakathi kwamagumbi angcwele endawo yonqulo.
Nanini na xa umgcini wam efika kwigumbi lam, wayefumana kum ukutya kwamaxesha onyaka okwakungafanele ukuba kube njalo.
Ndafumana iindaba ezimnandi zonyana, nangona iimeko zam zingandiniki ndawo yoko ndandikuthembisile.
Ndarhoxa ndaya kwindawo ekude, apho isundu lesundu landinika umthunzi ngelixa umlambo wawugeleza ngaphantsi.
Xa kwafika isityholo kunye nemibuzo indijikelezile, ndakhomba umntwana wam osandul’ ukuzalwa — waza wathetha esengumntwana ukuze athule onke amathandabuzo.

outcome.answer: Uhlonitshwe njengoyena mfazi uphakamileyo kunabo bonke

arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّۭا
verse: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. (19:24)
